name: Robin at the Frosted Gate
target_customer: Customers seeking a warm, traditional Christmas card for friends, family or neighbours

summary.style: Original hand-painted storybook watercolour for a premium Christmas greeting card, balancing tender naturalism with gentle festive fantasy.
summary.linework: Mostly outline-free, with only very fine, intermittent pencil-like detail marks for texture and definition.; Organic, softly broken and directional; painted edges feather naturally into the paper rather than forming crisp digital contours.
summary.detail: Medium to high detail, concentrated on the focal forms and a small number of atmospheric festive accents; distant or supporting elements remain soft and simplified for reliable home printing.
summary.palette: Muted traditional Christmas hues: cream and ivory, blue-grey winter tones, pine and sage greens, warm woodland browns, restrained berry red, and concentrated antique-gold highlights. (full colour)
summary.mood: Cosy, nostalgic, tender and quietly magical, with a refined handmade feel suited to seasonal gifting.

concepts.target_customer: Cottagecore and woodland-animal Christmas card buyers seeking a warm all-purpose card for friends and family
deliverable_components: Folded-card front with red fox carrying a small wrapped parcel through a snowy pine grove
Inside panel with a short separately typeset Christmas greeting and space to handwrite a message
Simple coordinating back panel with a small snow-drift and pine-sprig motif
concepts.short_description: A tender, general-use Christmas card in which a russet fox carries a little festive parcel through a peaceful watercolour winter woodland.
key_features: Portrait folded card printable on A4 or US Letter paper
Airy upper-front area for a crisp greeting such as “Christmas Wishes”
Storybook watercolour fox, snowy pine silhouettes and subtle antique-gold star flecks
Coordinated interior and back design without overcrowding the card
concepts.visual_direction_summary: Use the supplied nostalgic storybook watercolour system: a single believable-but-charming fox in three-quarter walking view across the lower middle, burgundy knitted scarf, kraft parcel with forest-green ribbon, layered blue-grey pines and generous ivory-sky space. Keep the atmosphere calm, softly textured and home-print-friendly.

concepts.target_customer: Adults looking for a thoughtful Christmas card for a neighbour, host, teacher or someone who has shown them kindness
deliverable_components: Folded-card front featuring the fox approaching a warmly suggested woodland clearing with its tiny parcel
Inside panel with a separately typeset message of thanks and Christmas wishes
Simple coordinating back panel with a small parcel-ribbon and falling-snow motif
concepts.short_description: A gratitude-led Christmas card that frames the fox’s tiny parcel as a gentle gesture of seasonal appreciation.
key_features: Designed for neighbours, hosts, teachers and everyday thank-yous
Front greeting area can carry wording such as “A Little Christmas Delivery”
The parcel becomes the central storytelling detail while the scene remains airy
Suitable for home printing and handwriting a personal note
concepts.visual_direction_summary: Retain the supplied watercolour palette, delicate broken ink accents and uncluttered woodland vignette, but give the fox’s parcel slightly more visual emphasis with a restrained ribbon curl and faint warm gold flecks nearby. Preserve the fox walking left to right along the lower portion, with no house, brand-like postal markings or busy prop clusters.

concepts.target_customer: People sending a seasonal card to friends or family members they cannot celebrate with in person
deliverable_components: Folded-card front with the fox travelling through softly falling snow, parcel held securely on its journey
Inside panel with a separately typeset long-distance Christmas message and writing space
Simple coordinating back panel with a small crescent pine-bough motif
concepts.short_description: A quietly heartfelt Christmas card for sending warmth across the miles, told through a fox making its way through a serene snowy grove.
key_features: Long-distance sentiment without relying on literal travel or postal imagery
Spacious, peaceful front composition that supports a clear greeting
Softly receding pine grove, snowbanks and sparse antique-gold stars create a sense of gentle distance
Family-friendly yet refined enough for adult recipients
concepts.visual_direction_summary: Follow the established hand-painted watercolour system, with the fox as the clear lower-middle focal point and a slightly more expansive sequence of pale blue-grey pines fading into the distance. Maintain creamy ivory snow, muted russet fur, burgundy scarf and restrained festive detail; reserve the upper third for separately typeset wording and avoid embedded illustration text.

pages.title: Merry Christmas
pages.concept: A European robin rests beside a weathered frosted cottage-garden gate at sunrise, with glowing holly forming a graceful lower vignette.
pages.artwork_description: A tender European robin with a warm russet breast perches on the top rail of a weathered wooden garden gate in the lower half of the panel. Frost catches the gate, soft sage foliage and pine sprigs, while a prominent holly sprig with restrained glossy berry-red berries curves up from the lower edge. The upper half is an airy ivory and pale peach winter sunrise sky with faint blue-grey distant garden shapes and a few soft snow-fleck accents. The printed greeting “Merry Christmas” sits clearly in the upper third in antique-gold serif lettering.
pages.generation_prompt: Portrait card front. A European robin perched on the top rail of a weathered frosted cottage-garden gate in the lower half, prominent holly sprig with red berries and frosted sage greenery framing the lower edge, pale peach winter sunrise sky opening above, soft distant blue-grey garden hints, a few subtle snow flecks. Exact title text in upper third: “Merry Christmas” in antique-gold serif lettering.
pages.production_notes: Verify the exact front text is “Merry Christmas” and remains highly legible against the pale sky. Keep robin, gate and holly away from trim-critical edges despite full-bleed artwork. Ensure the robin is clearly a European robin: russet-red breast, brown upperparts and small pointed beak.

pages.title: Inside Seasonal Message
pages.concept: A calm, coordinated writing panel with a short general-use festive message and a delicate winter-garden accent.
pages.artwork_description: An uncluttered warm-ivory interior panel with generous blank space for a handwritten note. Near the upper centre, the message reads “Wishing you a joyful Christmas and a happy New Year”. A small, soft watercolour vignette of a holly sprig, a single pale blue-grey feather and tiny frost flecks rests along the lower edge; the decoration remains light enough not to interfere with writing.
pages.generation_prompt: Portrait card inside panel with generous open writing space on warm ivory paper. Exact centred message near upper centre: “Wishing you a joyful Christmas and a happy New Year”. Delicate small lower-edge vignette of frosted holly leaves, a single blue-grey robin feather, a few pale snow flecks, and restrained antique-gold accent touches.
pages.production_notes: Verify exact message text and punctuation: “Wishing you a joyful Christmas and a happy New Year”. Maintain ample blank space below the message for handwriting; keep the lower vignette shallow and pale. Use a readable dark pine or warm brown text colour with strong contrast.

pages.title: Robin at the Frosted Gate
pages.concept: A discreet coordinating back panel featuring a small robin-feather and holly maker-style motif, without branding.
pages.artwork_description: A restrained warm-ivory back panel with a small centred lower-area vignette: one blue-grey robin feather crossed with a tiny frosted holly sprig and three berry-red berries. A faint wash of pale winter blue-grey sits behind the motif, leaving most of the panel airy and clean. No greeting, logo or website text appears.
pages.generation_prompt: Portrait card back panel, mostly open warm ivory field. Small centred lower-area motif: one blue-grey robin feather gently crossed with a tiny frosted holly sprig carrying exactly three berry-red berries, faint pale winter blue-grey wash behind it, a few subtle antique-gold specks. No text, no logo, no website.
pages.production_notes: No printed text, logo or website on this panel. Keep the motif modest and positioned clear of likely fold, trim and printer alignment variation. Supply printing and folding guidance separately as a non-artwork deliverable; explain correct front/inside/back placement for A4 and US Letter printing.

Original printable Christmas greeting-card artwork in a hand-painted storybook watercolour style: fine irregular pencil-and-ink accents, organic softly broken contours, medium-detail believable-but-charming woodland animals, translucent mottled pigment on subtle cold-pressed paper texture, muted russet, pine green, sage, blue-grey, creamy ivory, burgundy and restrained antique-gold palette. Soft layered winter shading, dry-brush snow, delicate fur and foliage marks, gentle warm star-fleck glow, airy pale background and an uncluttered upper-third area reserved for separately added greeting text. Portrait composition, calm cosy nostalgic mood, home-print-friendly focal shapes and clear value contrast.

STYLE PARAMETERS: illustration style: Original woodland winter greeting-card illustration with a single red fox delivering a small parcel through a snowy pine grove; hand-painted storybook watercolour with subtle ink detailing.; line weight: Fine, varied pencil-and-ink accents; delicate directional marks for fur, needles and parcel ribbon, with no heavy outlines.; line quality: Organic, softly broken and hand-rendered contours that dissolve naturally into watercolour edges.; detail level: Medium detail: a clear focal fox with tactile fur and knitted scarf, supported by simplified layered trees, snowdrifts, stars and a few restrained festive details suitable for reliable home printing.; character language: Broadly believable but gently charming fox anatomy, three-quarter side view in a walking pose; alert ears, small dark eyes, soft expression and an oversized russet tail. The fox wears a plain burgundy knitted scarf and carries a tiny wrapped kraft-paper parcel tied with a forest-green ribbon.; background density: Airy winter woodland vignette. Pale ivory sky, softly receding blue-grey pine silhouettes and rounded snowbanks leave generous uncluttered space in the upper third for a greeting added during layout.; composition: Portrait folded-card front, with the fox walking across the lower middle of the artwork from left to right. A loose crescent of snow-dusted pine boughs and faint falling snow frames the focal character without creating a border; preserve a clean upper-third text area.; palette: Muted russet and warm brown fox tones; pine green, blue-grey and soft sage shadows; creamy ivory snow; burgundy scarf; forest-green ribbon; restrained antique-gold star flecks.; colour mode: full colour; shading: Layered translucent watercolour washes, soft cool winter shadows and a gentle warm glow around a few antique-gold star flecks; no hard cel shading or large dark ink-heavy areas.; texture: Subtle cold-pressed paper grain, mottled pigment variation, dry-brush snow edges, fine fur strokes and softly granular snow specks.; mood: Tender, nostalgic, peaceful and quietly festive..

REFERENCE CHARACTERISTICS (general only, never copied): palette: Classic muted Christmas palette: evergreen, sage and pine; warm animal browns; creamy white snow and paper; antique gold; rusty red, burgundy, and occasional warm orange. Colours are earthy and gently desaturated rather than bright primary holiday hues.; linework: Reference 01 uses very fine, irregular pencil/ink-like contour and fur strokes, approximately 0.5–1 px at card-preview scale. References 02–03 are painterly and largely outline-free; forms are separated by value, texture, and rim light rather than graphic linework.; texture: Visible cold-pressed paper/wash texture, mottled pigment, soft dry-brush effects, fine fur strokes, knitted textile detail, granular snow, and bokeh-like light specks. Texture is decorative but supports form and atmosphere.; composition density: Varies from sparse portrait-led layout to dense cinematic vignettes. Use one clearly dominant focal subject; surrounding festive details should create a framing arc and depth without obscuring the subject.; background: From a near-white paper field with restrained flecks to layered, atmospheric winter environments. Complex scenes contain foreground, middle-ground, and softly receding background detail, with selective blur or low contrast at depth.; mood: Cosy, tender, nostalgic, magical, and quietly festive. The animals feel sweet and personable, while golden lighting conveys warmth and wonder..
